summary: Small rear shop car park; west side is about 38 m from the nearest homes.
reasons: Shops on west and south sides
Nearest houses 21 m+ from east edge

best_section.where: West edge of the small car park behind the shops, off the side lane

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto shop buildings and a garden centre; the nearest mapped houses are 21-28 m from the east edge, so about 35 m or more from the west edge, with trees between.
drivers.access_and_room: Enters from the lane on the south side; a sealed lot about 20 m by 12 m, with a van parked in it and room for one more.
drivers.traffic: Tucked behind the main road shops; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Appears to be private shop or staff parking; overnight rules unknown.

flags: Houses 21-28 m away to the east beyond trees
Mean grade 4.5% around outline, flat on the west edge
sun_shade: Open sealed surface; trees shade the east side in the morning, buildings shade the west side.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is gated at night
